hypothesis: Within the already-frozen v51 HYPE compression-pullback route, entries whose completed five-minute breakout direction agrees with the hourly structural entry side may retain stronger after-cost economics than opposed entries.
decision: Do not change or gate the live route from this post-hoc result. Declare relation-aware forward measurement from the artifact cutoff, exclude the current trigger lifecycle from prospective validation, and retain exact long/short and aligned/opposed attribution for every later resolved v51 lifecycle.
falsifier: Downgrade the alignment hypothesis if a predeclared later v51 window has complete causal relation attribution and aligned entries do not remain positive after actual costs, largest-winner removal, and side separation, or if opposed entries are comparably robust. Consider a separately versioned gate only after forward evidence covers both sides and both relation cohorts without technical gaps.

prospective_measurement.minimum_evidence_to_update_diagnosis: At least one later resolved exact-v51 lifecycle per configured side and relation, with actual fees, funding, slippage, latency, stop behavior, and complete entry telemetry.
prospective_measurement.minimum_evidence_for_change_recommendati: A predeclared compatible forward window with both sides, both relation cohorts, positive aligned economics after costs and largest-winner removal, technical completeness, and a separately versioned portfolio replay.

entry_execution.execution_interpretation: The 8.39-bps adverse reference-to-fill movement is not pure order-book slippage. A source-native book observed 5.80 seconds before order intent already had best bid 56.171, approximately 6.6 bps below the 56.208 decision reference. The order acknowledged in 1.30 seconds and the next observed book bracketed the fill. Across the only two exact v51 HYPE entries, signed slippage averages approximately 2.61 bps versus the 2-bps model; N=2 is insufficient to establish parity or degradation.

interim_path_at_2026_08_14T12_19_27Z.interpretation: The short remained directionally supported. The gross peak was approximately 23.8 bps of notional and did not establish a robust low-threshold profit-lock opportunity after entry fee, future exit fee, and exit slippage.

interim_path_at_2026_08_14T12_29_21Z.interpretation: The gross excursion reversed from +$11.82 to -$5.05 while canonical 1m/5m/15m structure remained directionally supportive for the short. This is direct giveback evidence, but the prior peak was only approximately 23.8 bps of notional and was barely above the estimated round-trip cost hurdle. One unresolved path does not justify adding a low-threshold profit lock or overriding the frozen exit contract.

interim_path_at_2026_08_14T12_46_50Z.interpretation: The position recovered from a -$6.99 gross trough to +$9.17 while canonical 1m/5m/15m structure remained directionally supportive for the short. The earlier giveback therefore does not by itself establish that the frozen no-target exit was defective. The lifecycle remains unresolved and must be scored only after the venue close, actual exit costs, funding, MFE, MAE, and exit reason reconcile.

interim_path_at_2026_08_14T13_12_18Z.interpretation: At one internally consistent checkpoint boundary, the still-supported native hold recovered beyond the prior gross peak and its estimated current exit led the already-triggered 25/15/10 profit-lock reference by $4.86 before funding and additional exit slippage. This provisional reversal directly falsifies selecting that low-threshold lock from the earlier giveback. It does not establish durable native-exit edge; exact scoring remains deferred until the venue lifecycle resolves.

interim_path_at_2026_08_14T13_29_17Z.interpretation: The same unresolved supported lifecycle later gave back its full favorable excursion; the 25/15/10 reference now leads the estimated native exit by $9.18 before funding and additional exit slippage. Together with the earlier opposite ranking, this shows material path dependence rather than a stable winner. The historical low-lock family remained negative across development folds, so this single path does not override the frozen exit or justify live promotion.

active_prospective_lifecycle.measurement_rule: Do not score, select, or change the live contract until the lifecycle closes and exact realized fees, funding, exit reason, exit slippage, MFE, MAE, and relation attribution reconcile.

recommendation.recommendation: Continue the exact v51 HYPE route while collecting relation-aware forward evidence; do not add an alignment gate yet.
recommendation.why_now: The first v51 HYPE entry exposed an opposed structural/breakout relation, and the exact frozen compression subset had not previously been partitioned by that relation.
evidence_reviewed: current v51 provisional HYPE entry context
recommendation.observed_problem_or_opportunity: The frozen compression subset separates materially: aligned development was positive and positive without its largest winner, whereas opposed development was negative on both sides. The later sample is too small and opposed results depend on one winner.
recommendation.applicable_market_regime: Fresh completed five-minute BREAKOUT onset after the frozen compression and non-chasing pullback conditions, with hourly structural side retained as entry authority.
alternatives_considered: replace structural side with breakout side
keep the route unchanged and predeclare forward relation measurement
recommendation.expected_upside: Preserves the current live translation test while creating a falsifiable path to identify whether opposed entries are a repeatable drag rather than normal subgroup variance.
recommendation.main_risks_and_failure_modes: The subgroup was chosen after inspection, the later sample has only four trades, fold stability is incomplete by side, the current trigger is not prospective evidence, and modeled one-minute friction cannot reproduce every live IOC fill.
recommendation.validation_completed: Exact source-time relation attribution, long/short separation, five chronological development folds, actual historical funding, modeled fees/slippage, MFE/MAE, exit reasons, drawdown, and largest-winner sensitivity were computed without replaying a new gate or changing occupancy.
recommendation.validation_still_required: Future exact-v51 resolved lifecycles after the cutoff, both relation cohorts on both sides, actual costs and stop behavior, and a separately versioned gated replay if the prospective evidence remains supportive.
recommendation.success_metrics: Aligned forward economics positive combined and by side, profit factor above one, positive after removing the largest winner, technical relation coverage complete, and opposed results materially weaker under the same contract.
recommendation.failure_or_rollback_triggers: Aligned forward results fail after costs or largest-winner removal; opposed results are equally robust; relation telemetry is incomplete; or a gate materially reduces opportunity without improving portfolio economics.
recommendation.confidence_level: medium for the historical separation; low for a deployable gate

single_highest_value_next_investigation: Resolve the current HYPE lifecycle, then collect the next exact v51 HYPE entry on the missing side/relation cells before spending more trials on thresholds or exits.
